## General procedure

- We could access all the information by changing the date in the url or in the API request

- We created an specific function for each page to create date vectors with specific formats for each scraper and API

## Box Office Mojo scraper

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}
- Title
- Image of the movie
- Date
- Daily earninings 
- Worlwide earnings
- Distributor
- Genres
- Running time
- Description
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{r}
#| echo: TRUE
#| eval: FALSE
#| code-line-numbers: "|6||19|28|29"

 movies <- movies  |> 
    mutate(day = gsub("\\D", "", substr(Date, 1, 6)),
           month = substr(Date, 1, 3),
           year = year) |>  
    mutate(date = paste(day, month, year, sep = " "),
           date = as.Date(date, format = "%d %b %Y")) |> 
    select(-c(Date, day, month, year)) |> 
    mutate(Gross = as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", Gross))) |> 
    rename(
      daily_earnings = Gross,
      best_selling = "#1 Release")
#-----------------------------------------------------------
links <- function(url) {
  Sys.sleep(2)
  
  page <- read_html(url)
 
  links <- page |> 
    xml_find_all("//td[@class = 'a-text-left mojo-field-type-release mojo-cell-wide']//a") |> 
    xml_attr(attr = "href") |> 
    str_remove_all("_\\d+$") |> 
    unique() %>% 
    paste0("https://www.boxofficemojo.com", .)
  
  return(links)
}
#----------------------------------------------------------- 
xml_find_all("//span[@class='money']")
xml_find_all("//div[@class = 'a-section a-spacing-none mojo-summary-values mojo-hidden-from-mobile']//span[not(@*)]")
```

:::

## New York Times API

<div style="text-align: center;">
  <img src="images/dates.png" width="600">
</div>

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE
#| eval: FALSE
news <- news |> 
  mutate(date = str_remove_all(date,"T.+$")) |> 
  mutate(date = str_trim(date)) |>     
  mutate(date = as_date(date)) |>  
  mutate(rank = row_number())  |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  slice_min(rank) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-rank)
```
